neighbours.label: An opening square bracket fused into one token with the symbol right after it (a quote mark, #, @, minus sign, ( or {), in code or prose, strongest with a space before the bracket; it lights up on that bracket token. A square bracket standing alone (followed by a letter, a digit or a space) stays weak, and a quote after ( or { stays quiet.
